metadata.title: Refund and cancellation policy · Outvers
metadata.description: Outvers refund policy explained — Flexible, Moderate, Strict presets, refund SLA, vendor-cancelled bookings, and how to request a cashout from your wallet.

calculator.heading: See your exact refund before you book
calculator.description: Enter a booking total, pick the preset, and choose when you would cancel. We run the same refund calculation the money path uses — so the figure here is the figure you would get.
calculator.promptEmpty: Enter an amount and both dates to see your refund.
calculator.promptInvalid: Your cancellation is on or after the start time, so it falls outside the policy window and would open a support dispute rather than an automatic refund.
calculator.walletNoteBody: An eligible refund credits your Refund balance — the cash-returnable bucket of your two-bucket Wallet. You can spend it on a future booking or cash it out to your original payment method (5–7 working days). It is not Outvers credit, which is promotional and spendable on Outvers only.

hero.title: Refund and cancellation policy
hero.description: Every Outvers Experience has one of three named cancellation presets — Flexible, Moderate, or Strict. The preset is locked when you book and is shown on every Experience card, the checkout page, the confirmation email, and the WhatsApp confirmation. Refund math is a pure function of the preset, your cancellation timestamp, and the booking total. No human review inside the policy window.

examples.heading: Worked examples
examples.flexibleTitle: A short day trip — Rishikesh rafting at 9 AM Saturday
examples.flexibleBody: Cancel by Friday 9 AM → full refund. Cancel Friday 9 AM to Saturday 7 AM → 50% refund. After 7 AM Saturday → no refund.
examples.moderateTitle: A weekend trek starting Saturday 6 AM
examples.moderateBody: Cancel by Wednesday 6 AM → full refund. Cancel Wednesday 6 AM to Friday 6 AM → 50% refund. After Friday 6 AM → no refund.
examples.strictTitle: A multi-day Himalayan trek starting on the 20th
examples.strictBody: Cancel by the 6th → full refund. Cancel between the 6th and the 13th → 50% refund. After the 13th → no refund.

specialCases.heading: Special cases
specialCases.vendorCancelledBody: If a vendor cancels — weather, equipment failure, staffing — you receive a 100% refund regardless of preset. The vendor's response-time SLA score takes a hit.
specialCases.outsideWindowBody: If you cancel after the experience start time, the cancellation opens a dispute. Resolution is at admin discretion; declined by default except in clear vendor-fault cases.
specialCases.customPoliciesBody: A small number of high-altitude expeditions and festival-day experiences have a Custom policy with non-refundable permits or guide deposits. These are admin-approved at listing time and shown in plain language on the Experience page.

refundSla.heading: When you'll see the money
refundSla.body: Eligible refunds credit to your Outvers wallet within 24 hours of an inside-policy cancellation. The wallet balance is spendable on any future booking; you can request a cashout to your original payment method any time — Razorpay round-trips bank transfers in 5–7 working days.

questions.heading: Still have questions?
questions.body: Email {email} or use the in-app chat on any booking — disputes filed inside the policy window are resolved within 48 hours.

metadata.title: Safety and trust · Outvers
metadata.description: How Outvers builds trust: a three-tier KYC verification ladder for vendors, transparent cancellation presets with SLA-backed wallet refunds, partial pay, surfaced permit requirements, and a notification-based safety stack.

hero.title: Safety and trust at Outvers
hero.description: Outvers is an adventure marketplace, so trust is the product. We do not own the rafts, the harnesses, or the trails — independent vendors do. Our job is to verify who they are, make the money rules predictable, and notify the right people when something goes wrong. Everything below is a feature that exists today, not a promise. Where Outvers does not do something — like obtaining your permits or dispatching emergency services — we say so plainly.

kyc.heading: Every vendor climbs a three-tier verification ladder
kyc.intro: A vendor's KYC tier decides what they are allowed to list and transact. The badge on each Experience card tells you exactly how far a vendor has been verified — verification and responsiveness are tracked separately, so the badge is about identity, not popularity.
kyc.phoneBody: An OTP-confirmed phone number at signup. A Phone verified vendor can draft Experiences but cannot publish, accept bookings, or receive payouts. No badge appears on listings at this tier.
kyc.identityBody: Aadhaar eKYC plus a format-validated PAN, with at least one Experience reviewed by an admin. An Identity verified vendor may publish single-day Experiences up to Rs.5,000 per person and 8 participants per slot, and carries the "Identity verified" badge.
kyc.businessBody: Identity verification plus a recorded video-call check of premises and equipment, a GSTIN or a below-threshold self-declaration with Udyam registration, and the category-relevant guide certifications (for example ATOAI, RMI, NIM, or APPI). A Business verified vendor has unrestricted listing rights and carries the "Business verified" badge.

money.heading: The money rules are written down before you pay
money.cancellationTitle: Three cancellation presets, locked at booking
money.cancellationBody: Every Experience uses one of three named cancellation presets — Flexible, Moderate, or Strict. The preset is locked when you book and shown on the Experience card, the checkout page, and your confirmation. Refund math is a pure function of the preset, your cancellation time, and the booking total — no human review inside the policy window. Read the full breakdown on our cancellation policy page.
money.walletTitle: Two-bucket wallet — Outvers credit and Refund balance
money.walletBody: Your Wallet shows two separate buckets. Outvers credit is promotional balance from referrals and offers — spendable on Outvers bookings only. Refund balance is real money: an inside-policy cancellation auto-credits it within minutes, and you can cash it back to your original payment method via a 5–7 working-day Razorpay round-trip. A vendor-cancelled booking is always a full refund regardless of preset.
money.partialPayTitle: Partial pay — a 25% Advance now, the rest at T-24h
money.partialPayBody: For eligible bookings you pay a 25% Advance at booking time, and the remaining 75% is auto-captured 24 hours before the Experience starts. You see both figures before you commit, so there is no surprise charge.

onground.heading: On the ground: permits surfaced, safety notified
onground.permitsBody: Some Experiences sit in permit-gated areas (for example Inner Line Permits or wildlife-area entry). Outvers surfaces each required permit in plain language with a link to the official application and a mandatory acknowledgement before you book. To be clear: Outvers does not obtain permits on your behalf — we tell you exactly what you need and where to get it.
onground.safetyStackTitle: The safety stack: trusted contact, SOS, and check-in pings
onground.safetyStackBody: Experiences that need it — treks, paragliding, scuba, rafting, and high-flagged regions — turn on the safety stack. You record a trusted contact before booking. During an active booking you can trigger an SOS event, which fans out a WhatsApp and SMS notification to your trusted contact, the vendor, and Outvers ops, with your location if we can capture it. Automated check-in pings ask "arrived safely?" at trip start and end.
onground.postureTitle: A notification tool, not an emergency service
onground.postureBody: Outvers SOS notifies people; it does not dispatch emergency services and does not promise a response. In a life-threatening emergency, dial 112. Routine location is visible only to you and is auto-deleted 72 hours after a trip ends — we keep no standing surveillance log.

contact.heading: Questions about safety?
contact.body: Email {email} and our team will help — disputes filed inside the policy window are resolved within 48 hours.

metadata.title: About Outvers · India's adventure-activity marketplace
metadata.description: Outvers connects adventure-seeking customers across India with KYC-verified independent vendors — rafting operators, paragliding outfits, trekking companies, and more — with transparent pricing and refunds.

hero.title: About Outvers
hero.description: Outvers is an Indian adventure-activity marketplace. We connect customers who want to raft, trek, paraglide, dive, and explore with independent vendors who run those Experiences — verified, priced transparently, and bookable in a few taps.

mission.heading: Our mission
mission.body: India's adventure-activity market is enormous and fragmented — thousands of skilled local operators, most without an online storefront, and customers who struggle to tell a verified outfit from a risky one. Outvers exists to close that gap honestly: bring real operators online, verify who they are, and make the rules of money and safety predictable for everyone.

howItWorks.heading: How Outvers works
howItWorks.browseBody: Search single-day and multi-day Experiences across regions and activities. Pricing brackets, availability, and the cancellation preset are shown up front.
howItWorks.bookBody: Eligible bookings use partial pay — a 25% Advance now, the rest auto-captured 24 hours before you go. Refunds follow a fixed cancellation preset, never a case-by-case guess.
howItWorks.trustBody: Every vendor climbs a three-tier KYC ladder — Phone verified, Identity verified, Business verified — and the badge on each listing tells you how far they got. For higher-risk activities, a safety stack adds a trusted contact, SOS notifications, and check-in pings.

honesty.heading: What we are — and what we are not
honesty.body: Outvers is a marketplace. The Experiences are operated by independent third-party vendors, not by Outvers. We verify vendors, hold the money rules, and notify your contacts when you trigger SOS — but we do not run the trips ourselves, we do not obtain permits on your behalf, and our SOS is a notification tool, not an emergency response service. Being clear about this is part of the trust.

contact.body: Reach us at {email}. If you operate adventure Experiences and want to list them, start with vendor onboarding.

metadata.title: Help centre · Outvers
metadata.description: Answers to common questions about booking adventure Experiences on Outvers — Partial pay, the Cancellation policy presets, your two-bucket Wallet, KYC-verified Vendors, Required permits, and the Safety stack.

hero.title: How can we help?
hero.description: Answers to the questions Customers ask most — about booking, payments, refunds, your Wallet, Vendor verification, and safety on Outvers.

whatIsOutvers.question: What is Outvers?
whatIsOutvers.answer: Outvers is an Indian adventure-activity marketplace where you book Experiences — rafting, paragliding, treks and more — run by independent Vendors. Every Vendor is KYC-verified, every Experience shows a clear Cancellation policy, and slot availability is real-time so you only ever book a slot that still has room.

howToBook.question: How do I book an Experience?
howToBook.answer: Open the Experience page, pick an available slot and your participant count, then continue to checkout. Your per-person price follows the Group-size bracket (1-2, 3-5, or 6+) for your party. You confirm and pay with Razorpay; your Booking is confirmed the moment payment is captured.

partialPay.question: Do I have to pay the full amount upfront?
partialPay.answer: Most Bookings 48 hours or more away and up to Rs.25,000 default to Partial pay: Outvers captures a 25% Advance when you book, and the remaining 75% is auto-captured 24 hours before the Experience starts. The exact Advance and balance are shown on the checkout page before you pay.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel, and how much do I get back?
cancellation.answer: Each Experience uses one of three Cancellation policy presets — Flexible, Moderate, or Strict — chosen by the Vendor and locked onto your Booking when you book. How much is refundable depends on how far ahead of the start time you cancel. The exact figure is on the Experience page and in your booking confirmation, and you can preview it with the refund calculator on our cancellation policy page.

refundBalance.question: Where does my refund go, and can I get cash back?
refundBalance.answer: An inside-policy cancellation auto-credits your Refund balance with no human review, usually within 24-48 hours. Your Refund balance defaults to a Wallet credit you can spend on your next Booking, but it is cashable back to your original payment method on request — a 5-7 working-day Razorpay round-trip.

walletBuckets.question: What is the difference between Outvers credit and Refund balance?
walletBuckets.answer: Your Wallet holds two separate buckets. Outvers credit is promotional balance from referrals, festive promos and loyalty rewards — spendable only on Outvers Bookings and never cashable, and it expires 12-18 months after it is issued. Refund balance is your accrued refunds, which you can spend on Bookings or cash out to your bank.

vendorVerification.question: How do I know a Vendor is trustworthy?
vendorVerification.answer: Every Vendor passes KYC before they can transact. An Identity verified Vendor has cleared Aadhaar and PAN checks; a Business verified Vendor has additionally cleared a video call, GSTIN or self-declaration, and category-relevant guide certifications. Each Vendor's verification badge and Response-time SLA score are shown on their profile.

permits.question: Do I need a permit for some Experiences?
permits.answer: Some Experiences are permit-gated and need a Required permit — for example an Inner Line Permit or a wildlife-area entry. Outvers surfaces the requirement on the Experience page and links you to the official process. In v1 you obtain the permit yourself; Outvers does not obtain permits on your behalf.

safetyStack.question: What safety features does Outvers offer?
safetyStack.answer: Experiences flagged for it use the Safety stack: a Trusted contact you record before booking, automated check-in pings at trip start and end, an SOS button, and ephemeral live-location sharing. On an SOS trigger, Outvers notifies your Trusted contact, the Vendor, and Outvers ops by WhatsApp and SMS — Outvers notifies, it does not dispatch.
